name: Windows Installer
scope_guardrails: PKG-04 updater and recovery remains out of scope
PKG-05 Linux/macOS release remains out of scope
PKG-06 security certification and PKG-08 pentest remain later packages
production signing secrets are external handles only
firewall/hosts/resolver/trust-store mutation is not an installer side effect
parallel execution is dependency-gated and limited to five active tasks

tasks.name: Activate PKG-03 execution authority and freeze Windows installer architecture, format, identity and ownership contract
Deterministic GitHub-hosted Windows bundle build and artifact manifest
Package identity, version, publisher and upgrade metadata contract
Install-scope and elevation contract for per-user and per-machine modes
Owned payload/resource manifest and install-root containment
NSIS current-user interactive install and uninstall lifecycle
NSIS per-machine elevated install and uninstall lifecycle
MSI/WiX enterprise install, uninstall and Add/Remove Programs lifecycle
Desktop Start Menu, shortcut and application-registration lifecycle
CLI and Agent payload placement, discovery and launch contract
VSN Agent Windows service install, start, health and removal lifecycle
Installer ACLs, state/config directories and user-data separation
Firewall, hosts, resolver and trust-store non-mutation boundary
Installed payload integrity and repair detection for missing or tampered owned files
Installer logging, deterministic exit codes, cancellation and operator diagnostics
Idempotent reinstall and repair lifecycle
Uninstall owned-artifact cleanup with user-data preservation
Transactional install failure rollback and interrupted-install recovery
Running Desktop, CLI and Agent handling with Restart Manager/service coordination
Reboot-required, no-restart and pending-reboot semantics
Unattended and silent NSIS/MSI deployment contract
Authenticode signing integration and signature-verification gate
Installer hash, SBOM/provenance manifest and PKG-05 release handoff
Fresh and dirty Windows VM install/repair/uninstall acceptance matrix
Final Windows installer exact-head gate, full PKG-03 regression matrix and PKG-04 handoff

resume.cursor_rule: active_task is the lowest-ID READY/IN_PROGRESS task; null while dormant or complete
